candidates.name: Division 10, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Services page lists installation crews for toilet partitions, toilet accessories, operable partitions and lockers; toilet partitions are also a product line.
red_flags: Sells and supplies toilet partitions itself (dealer since 1989 for Bobrick, ASI/Accurate, Scranton, Bradley, Metpar and others): high buy-around risk
Brand list read from manufacturer logos on the manufacturers page, not page text
candidates.reason: A Memphis-area Division 10 specialty supplier with its own install crews for toilet partitions, serving contractors on commercial projects. It installs partitions, but it is also a direct partition dealer and so competes with Next Partitions.

license.name: Division 10, Inc.
license.registry: Tennessee Board for Licensing Contractors license search (verify.tn.gov, now search.cloud.commerce.tn.gov); Memphis and Shelby County Office of Construction Code Enforcement contractor registration (Accela, aca-prod.accela.com/SHELBYCO)
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. The state search (verify.tn.gov redirects to search.cloud.commerce.tn.gov) is a JavaScript app (Tyler Technologies) with a reCAPTCHA check, so automated lookup was not possible and no official record was read. I found no public read-only Memphis/Shelby County registered-contractor list. The Accela portal needs a form search, which I didn't run. The company site (http://www.division10inc.com/) shows a Cordova, TN base, company phones (901) 755-2623 and (901) 753-8469, and the services 'Product sales, estimating services, installation quotes'. It doesn't name toilet partitions and shows no license number. A web search found no license record. Next step: search the TN license lookup by hand and confirm Memphis/Shelby registration with the Code Enforcement licensing section.
